name: Merge PDF
description: Combine multiple document sections or pages into a clean, metadata-free PDF file right in your browser.

seo.metaTitle: Merge PDF — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Combine multiple document sections or pages into a clean, metadata-free PDF file right in your browser. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/pdf-merge-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Merge PDF processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/pdf-merge-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Merge PDF upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Merge PDF executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-merge-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Merge PDF upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Merge PDF executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-merge-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Merge PDF?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/pdf_merge.json or open /tools/pdf-merge?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.

steps: Select or drag and drop your PDF document into the tool.
